<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Synthetic\Accessors\Formats;

use Synthetic\Accessors\Accessor;

/** Reads `KEY=value` lines. Blank lines and lines that start with `#` are skipped; a value may be wrapped in one pair of matching quotes. */
final class EnvAccessor implements Accessor
{
    /** @var array<string, string> */
    private array $values = [];

    public function __construct(string $source)
    {
        foreach (preg_split('/\r?\n/', $source) ?: [] as $raw) {
            $line = trim($raw);
            if ($line === '' || str_starts_with($line, '#')) {
                continue;
            }
            $eq = strpos($line, '=');
            if ($eq === false || $eq === 0) {
                continue;
            }
            $key = trim(substr($line, 0, $eq));
            $value = trim(substr($line, $eq + 1));
            if (strlen($value) >= 2 && ($value[0] === '"' || $value[0] === "'") && $value[strlen($value) - 1] === $value[0]) {
                $value = substr($value, 1, -1);
            }
            $this->values[$key] = $value;
        }
    }

    public function get(string $key, ?string $fallback = null): ?string
    {
        return $this->values[$key] ?? $fallback;
    }

    public function has(string $key): bool
    {
        return array_key_exists($key, $this->values);
    }

    public function all(): array
    {
        return $this->values;
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

require __DIR__ . '/../src/Accessor.php';
require __DIR__ . '/../src/Formats/EnvAccessor.php';
require __DIR__ . '/../src/Formats/JsonAccessor.php';

use Synthetic\Accessors\Formats\EnvAccessor;
use Synthetic\Accessors\Formats\JsonAccessor;

$failures = 0;
function check(string $name, bool $ok): void
{
    global $failures;
    echo ($ok ? "ok   " : "FAIL ") . $name . "\n";
    if (!$ok) {
        $failures++;
    }
}

$env = new EnvAccessor("HOST=localhost\nPORT=3000\n");
check('reads KEY=value lines', $env->get('HOST') === 'localhost' && $env->get('PORT') === '3000');

$env = new EnvAccessor("# a comment\n\nKEY=value\n");
check('skips blank lines and comments', $env->all() === ['KEY' => 'value']);

$env = new EnvAccessor("A=\"one two\"\nB='three'\n");
check('strips one pair of matching quotes', $env->get('A') === 'one two' && $env->get('B') === 'three');

$env = new EnvAccessor('KEY=value');
check('answers the fallback for a key that is not there', $env->get('MISSING', 'none') === 'none' && $env->has('KEY') && !$env->has('MISSING'));

$json = new JsonAccessor('{"name":"x","count":3}');
check('json keeps the string values of an object', $json->all() === ['name' => 'x']);

exit($failures === 0 ? 0 : 1);

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Synthetic\Accessors\Formats;

use Synthetic\Accessors\Accessor;

/** Reads `KEY=value` lines. Blank lines and lines that start with `#` are skipped; a value may be wrapped in one pair of matching quotes. */
final class EnvAccessor implements Accessor
{
    /** @var array<string, string> */
    private array $values = [];

    public function __construct(string $source)
    {
        foreach (preg_split('/\r?\n/', $source) ?: [] as $raw) {
            $line = trim($raw);
            if ($line === '' || str_starts_with($line, '#')) {
                continue;
            }
            $eq = strpos($line, '=');
            if ($eq === false || $eq === 0) {
                continue;
            }
            $key = trim(substr($line, 0, $eq));
            $value = trim(substr($line, $eq + 1));
            if (strlen($value) >= 2 && ($value[0] === '"' || $value[0] === "'") && $value[strlen($value) - 1] === $value[0]) {
                $value = substr($value, 1, -1);
            }
            $this->values[$key] = $value;
        }
    }

    public function get(string $key, ?string $fallback = null): ?string
    {
        return $this->values[$key] ?? $fallback;
    }

    public function has(string $key): bool
    {
        return array_key_exists($key, $this->values);
    }

    public function all(): array
    {
        return $this->values;
    }
}

input.title: EnvAccessor strips a leading `export` + blanks only when a key follows, in both packages
input.rationale: Lines written as `export KEY=value` (a shell habit) read as `KEY=value`. The prefix is `export` followed by spaces or tabs, removed only when the next character is neither `=` nor a blank, so a line that already meant a key named `export` (`export = x`, `export=1`) keeps its meaning instead of becoming `= x` and being skipped. The same pattern, `^export[ \t]+(?=[^= \t])`, is used in `packages/js` and `packages/php` (ADR-1), and with `[ \t]` rather than `\s` so the two languages cannot differ on Unicode whitespace. Tests in both packages cover the prefix, tab/multi-space/indented forms, and the keys that merely start with `export`.
input.alternatives: Plain `^export\s+` strip: rejected, it changes the meaning of an existing `export = x` line (key `export`) and `\s` differs between JS and PHP on Unicode whitespace. Accepting `export` with no following blank: rejected, `exporter=3` and `export=1` are ordinary keys. Doing JS first and PHP later: rejected by ADR-1.

content.text:
`EnvAccessor` now reads `export KEY=value` as `KEY=value`, in both the JS and PHP packages. Both test suites pass: JS 8 of 8, and PHP all checks `ok`.

- **Both packages:** the repo's ADR-1 requires a behavior change in one package to be made in the other in the same pull request. The change is in `packages/js/src/accessors/formats/env-accessor.ts` and `packages/php/src/Formats/EnvAccessor.php`, with the doc comments updated.
- **How the prefix is stripped:** `export` followed by spaces or tabs is removed from the trimmed line, so `export  KEY=v`, `export<TAB>KEY=v` and an indented `  export KEY=v` all give `KEY`.
- **Existing keys named `export` still work:** the prefix is removed only when a key follows it. `export=1` and `export = x` keep the key `export`, as before. `exporter=3` is unaffected.
